embeds.title: Verify
embeds.description: Press the button below to confirm that you have read, understand and will follow the server rules. You will get the **Verified** role.

embeds.title: Need help?
embeds.description: Press the button to open a private ticket. Only you and the NeonBeta team can see it. Please don’t share passwords or private details.

embeds.title: Welcome to NeonBeta 🎮
embeds.description:
We find game deals worth buying: free games, real historical lows and new releases, so you don’t have to dig through every sale.

**Start here**
1. Read #rules
2. Pick your alerts in #roles
3. Say hi in #general

embeds.title: Price alerts 🔔
embeds.description:
Want a ping when a game gets cheap?

**/alert add** game and the highest price you’d pay
**/alert list** to see your alerts
**/alert remove** to delete one

You can have up to 5 alerts. Use the full game name for the best match.
